days.label: Push Day ? Chest, Shoulders & Triceps
days.warmup: 5 min light cardio + arm circles + band pull-aparts

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.notes: Staying at 135 ? no logs came in this week, so nothing changes. This is two weeks in a row at this weight with no data. Show up Monday and get it done. Touch the chest, full 1-second pause, drive through the heels, stay braced throughout. Need 9-10 reps across all three sets at RPE 7 to earn 140. Take the full 90 seconds between sets and log every rep and RPE.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.notes: Staying at 45 ? no logs this week, no movement. Last data we had was 10/9/8 at RPE 8/8/8. Sets 2 and 3 were slipping. 30-degree incline, elbows at 45, 2-second negative. Need 10/10/10 at RPE 7 to earn 50. Stop letting the later sets fall off ? that's the pattern to break.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.notes: Staying at 35 ? no logs this week. Last session was 8/8/8 at RPE 9/9/9 ? that's grinding, not owning the weight. Press straight up, full lockout, no lean back. You need all three sets to drop to RPE 7-8 before we touch the weight. Focus on breathing and control, not just surviving the set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercises.notes: Staying at 15 ? no logs this week. Last logged was 10/10/10 at RPE 8/8/8 ? bottom of the range, effort too high. Slight elbow bend, lead with the elbows, 2-second hold at the top, slow the negative. Stop swinging. Need 12/12/12 at RPE 7 to earn 20. Add two reps per set this week.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
exercises.notes: Staying at 95 ? no logs this week so the bump to 100 is on hold. Last known data was 10/10/10 at RPE 7/7/7 ? that earned the increase, but we need to confirm it in a logged session first. Hands shoulder-width, elbows tucked, lower to the chest, full lockout every rep. Log all three sets and that 100 lb bump is yours next week.

exercises.name: Tricep Rope Pushdown
exercises.notes: ROTATION IN ? swapping out Dumbbell Overhead Tricep Extension this week for variety. Rope attachment on the cable, elbows pinned to your sides, push down and split the rope at the bottom for full extension, controlled return. Pick a weight where 10-12 reps is RPE 7. Log the weight ? this is a baseline session.

days.cooldown: Stretch chest, shoulders, and triceps ? 5 min

days.label: Pull Day ? Back, Biceps & Rear Delts
days.warmup: 5 min light cardio + band pull-aparts + cat-cow stretches

exercises.name: Barbell Deadlift
exercises.notes: Staying at 195 ? no logs this week, nothing moves. Last data was 8/8/8 at RPE 8/8/9 ? set 3 was pushing the limit. Lats tight before you break the floor, bar dragging up the shins, full breath and brace before every rep. Take the full 2 minutes between sets ? don't shortchange recovery. Need 8+ reps on all three sets at RPE 7 or lower to earn 205. Log it.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.notes: Staying at 110 ? no logs this week. Last session was 10/9/8 at RPE 7/8/8 ? set 1 solid, sets 2 and 3 losing reps and gaining RPE. Wide grip, pull to upper chest, hard lat squeeze at the bottom, stay upright ? do not row it down. Need 10/10/10 at RPE 7 to earn 120. The set-to-set drop-off is the thing to fix.

exercises.name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
exercises.notes: ROTATION IN ? swapping out Dumbbell Single-Arm Row this week for variety. Hinge at the hips, flat back, pull the bar to your lower chest, squeeze the lats at the top, controlled descent. Pick a weight where 8-10 reps is RPE 7. Log the weight ? this is a baseline session.

exercises.name: Cable Face Pull
exercises.notes: Staying at 70 ? no logs this week. Last session was 12/12/12 at RPE 7/8/8 ? set 1 clean but sets 2 and 3 climbed. Rope at upper pulley, pull to your face, thumbs pointing behind you at the finish, elbows high, full external rotation. Need 15/15/15 at RPE 7 to earn 75. Push the rep count on every set.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.notes: Staying at 35 ? no logs this week. The bump to 35 was earned two weeks ago (10/10/10 at RPE 7/7/7 at 30 lbs), but we haven't confirmed how 35 actually feels. Neutral grip, elbows pinned, no swinging, full curl, controlled negative. Log how it goes across all three sets ? RPE data matters here.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curl
exercises.notes: Staying in rotation ? dumbbell curl was introduced last week as a baseline session but no logs came in. Alternating or simultaneous, elbows pinned to your sides, supinate at the top, controlled negative. Pick a weight where 8-10 reps is RPE 7. Log the weight ? still treating this as the baseline session.

days.cooldown: Stretch lats, biceps, and upper back ? 5 min

days.label: Leg Day ? Quads, Hamstrings, Glutes & Core
days.warmup: 5 min light cardio + bodyweight squats + leg swings

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.notes: Staying at 165 ? no logs this week, so nothing changes. Last data was 8/8/8 at RPE 8/8/8 ? stuck at 8 reps and stuck at RPE 8. Below parallel, big breath before you unrack, brace hard, drive through the heels, chest up out of the hole. Take the full 2 minutes ? no shortcuts. Need 9-10 reps on all three sets at RPE 7 or under to earn 175. The rep count is the thing to attack Friday.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Staying at 155 ? no logs this week. Last session was 10/9/10 at RPE 7/8/8 ? set 1 great, sets 2 and 3 lost a rep and effort climbed. Slight knee bend, hips back, bar close to the legs, feel the hamstring stretch at the bottom, do not let the lower back round. Need 10/10/10 at RPE 7 to earn 165. Sets 2 and 3 are where you're losing it.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Walking Lunges
exercises.notes: ROTATION IN ? swapping out Bulgarian Split Squat this week for variety. Long stride for glutes, short stride for quads ? pick one and be consistent. Dumbbells at your sides, controlled descent, drive through the front heel to stand. Pick a weight where 10-12 reps per leg is RPE 7. Log the weight ? this is a baseline session.

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
exercises.notes: Staying at 85 ? no logs this week. Last session was 12/10/10 at RPE 8/8/8 ? set 1 hit 12 reps but sets 2 and 3 fell to 10 with high effort throughout. Upper back on the bench, drive through the heels, full hip extension, hard squeeze at the top for a full second, controlled descent. Need 12/12/12 at RPE 7 to earn 90. Don't let sets 2 and 3 fall apart.

exercises.name: Leg Curl
exercises.notes: Staying at 55 ? no logs this week. Last session was 13/14/15 at RPE 8/8/8 ? rep count was building nicely but effort was still too high across all sets. Curl the heels toward the glutes, full ROM, controlled return ? no jerking. Need 15/15/15 at RPE 7 to earn 60. You're close on reps, now get the RPE down.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
exercises.notes: Staying in rotation ? cable crunch was introduced last week as a baseline session but no logs came in. Kneel facing the pulley, rope behind your head, crunch with your abs ? not your hips. Don't just pull the weight down with your arms. Pick a weight where 10-12 reps is RPE 7. Log the weight ? still treating this as the baseline session.

days.cooldown: Stretch quads, hamstrings, hip flexors ? 5 min
